description: Manages user profiles, personal information, and preferences for authenticated users.

endpoints.name: UpdateProfile
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's profile information.

profile.description: Updated profile model containing new information. Fields like Email, FirstName, LastName are optional.

example_uses: Update my profile with a new email address.
Change my first and last name in my user profile.
I want to update my contact details.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when a user wants to update their basic profile information such as email, first name, or last name.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserInfo
endpoints.description: Updates current user's information and profile settings.

userInfo.description: Updated user information object containing profile changes. Required fields include UserId, TextToSpeech, Id, Status, CreatedBy, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy, IsDeleted, and DeletedBy.

example_uses: Update my user settings, including text-to-speech preference.
Change my organizational unit and language settings.
I need to update my user ID and status.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update comprehensive user information, including system-level settings like user ID, text-to-speech preference, language, and organizational unit.

endpoints.name: GetUserProfileDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves comprehensive current user information including profile, roles, permissions, organizational settings, and user preferences. Supports both authenticated user lookup and explicit email parameter for administrative purposes.

email.description: Optional specific email to get user info for (if not provided, uses current authenticated user).

example_uses: Get my current user profile details.
Show me all my user settings and preferences.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the complete profile and settings for the current authenticated user, or for a specific user if an email is provided (for administrative access).
